name: Grabbing Master
prerequisites: Grabbing Drag, Grabbing Style, Improved Grapple; base attack bonus +12, brawler level 8th, or monk level 8th
benefit:
When you are grabbing two opponents while using Grabbing Style, you can use your grapple to move or damage one or both opponents you are grappling, instead of just one.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 120
When you are grappling only one opponent while using Grabbing Style, you can spend 5 stamina points to continue to threaten the area within your reach with your free hand until the beginning of your next turn.
flavor: You can grapple two foes as easily as one.
